decisions.reason: Although it stayed visible for two years, this schlager compilation appears less distinctive for the firm's niche collector positioning and shows no sign of continued support after 2019.
An illustrated release series fits the firm's curated specialist identity, adds collectible value for fans, and remained prominently presented beyond launch.
The jazz vinyl reissue matches the collector market, but with only launch-year visibility it looks more like a limited one-off than a title worth continuing in 2022.
A multi-disc box set suits collectors but is capital-intensive, and the lack of continued website presence suggests resources are better shifted to new curated releases.
This compilation received only a brief mention rather than a dedicated presentation, indicating weak traction and low strategic importance.
